stem.text: Outbreaks of cholera commonly occur in camps that are set up after a major natural disaster.
The list shows some control measures that can be taken to limit the spread of cholera in the camps.

items: treating all drinking water supplies with a high concentration of chlorine
setting up an emergency treatment centre to isolate cases of cholera and treat them with antibiotics
using concentrated disinfectant to clean sewage disposal areas and infected bedding
health workers visiting regularly to detect cases
keeping good records of the number of cases and deaths at treatment centres

stem.text: Which features of these control measures involve an economic factor?
